description: Representative probes for real lazy forms that are not unavailable stubs. Full workbook-backed coverage lives in unit/integration tests; this suite keeps the oracle catalog from treating their existence as part of the external-stub bucket.

cases.skipped: Excel's PHONETIC takes a reference, so a string literal is refused at entry and leaves no reading. `=PHONETIC(A1)` over an unannotated text cell returns the text on both engines and is captured as lazy_phonetic_unannotated_cell; the annotated and partially annotated cases are pinned against a hand-built rPh package Excel was asked to open. Windows Excel 365 ja-JP 16.0.20326 refuses it at entry as well (COM 0x800A03EC, recorded as a driver skip in tests/oracle/variants/win-365-ja_JP/golden/), so no Excel host produces a value.
